reason: Classified as a data-processing utility because the plugin is explicitly described as a DeepSeek Harness plugin that records daily check-ins, tracks token/cost usage, and shows reports by day or model through local JSON-ledger data and a web dashboard. The feature set is centered on cost/accounting and usage visibility rather than code creation, search, or external collaboration functions.

summaries.zh: 这是一个面向 DeepSeek Harness 的本地化插件，用于每日打卡并按天、按模型记录 token 与费用，可通过命令查询并在网页浮窗中查看统计。
summaries.en: This is a local DeepSeek Harness plugin for daily check-ins and token/cost accounting by day and model, with command-driven access and a web floating panel for usage reporting.

capabilities: Captures and aggregates model token usage/cost data from DeepSeek Harness calls.
Persists daily check-in and pricing history in local JSON files.
Provides reporting and trend views for usage and cost by day/model through a floating web interface.
Supports command-driven operations for check-in, status, and report retrieval.
